parameters.query:
SELECT ticket_id, status, remote_message_id, category
FROM support_tickets 
WHERE contact_id = $1 
  AND status IN ('open', 'pending_client', 'in_progress', 'implementation') 
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO support_tickets (
    contact_id, 
    category, 
    priority, 
    status, 
    description, 
    created_at, 
    updated_at
) 
VALUES (
    $1, 
    $2, 
    'medium', 
    'open', 
    $3, 
    NOW(), 
    NOW()
) 
RETURNING ticket_id, status, priority;

INSERT INTO support_dify_locks (contact_id) 
VALUES ($1) 
ON CONFLICT (contact_id) DO NOTHING 
RETURNING contact_id;

UPDATE leads_pipeline
SET conversation_id = $1
WHERE contact_id = $2 
  AND (conversation_id IS NULL OR conversation_id = '');
